name: imprint-near-tolerance-non-positive-volume
error: op 9 Imprint { object: 1, face: 4, points: [[0.25, 1.1250010000000001, 0.05500000000000001], [0.25, 1.200001, 0.05500000000000001], [0.25, 1.200001, 0.07500000000000001], [0.25, 1.1250010000000001, 0.07500000000000001]] }: validator rejected the result: kernel bug, operation rolled back: 1 topology violation(s); NonPositiveVolume(0.0) -- CI fuzzer, 2026-10-11 (run 38186357264). Cause: not the loop (it sits 25 mm clear of every edge) but the side face it was imprinted on: a notch plus three collinear vertices on one edge made earcut bridge the new hole wrongly, its triangles missed 1.9% of the face, and Object::volume() turned that TessellateError into a volume of 0. Fixed: sawhorse-tessellate falls back to its own ear clipper when earcut's area check fails; Object::validate reports a face that cannot be triangulated as Violation::Untessellatable instead of NonPositiveVolume(0); faceops::imprint refuses (SelfIntersecting) a loop whose corner lies within POINT_MERGE of a side it does not belong to (tests/imprint_tolerance.rs).
